name: whois
description: Look up WHOIS registration information for a domain (registrar, registrant, creation/expiry dates, nameservers). Call with action='lookup' to fetch raw WHOIS data for a domain, or action='parse' with raw whois_data text to extract structured fields from it.

action.description: lookup: fetch WHOIS data for a domain. parse: extract structured fields (registrar, dates, nameservers) from raw WHOIS text you already have.

domain.description: The domain name to look up (e.g. 'example.com'). Required for action='lookup'.

whois_data.description: Raw WHOIS text to parse. Required for action='parse' - typically the whois_data field from a prior lookup result.
